q1.a: JeniusAcademy is a web-based online learning platform offering video lessons, practice questions and progress tracking across several education levels.

q2.a: Yes. Elementary and junior high classes are free. Senior high and UTBK prep are available through subscription plans.

q3.a: Create an account, open the Plans page and choose the level you need. Payment method details will be available once payments go live.

q4.a: Yes. When you are logged in, your progress is saved to your account and available on any device. Without an account it is stored only on the device you use.

q5.q: Can I learn on my phone?
q5.a: Yes. The site is responsive and comfortable to use on phones, tablets and laptops.

q6.q: What if I have other questions?
q6.a: Reach us through the contact details at the bottom of this page. We're happy to help.
